P2P baby-monitor web app: WebRTC (PeerJS), Vite + TypeScript. Baby Station streams camera/mic; Parent Station receives stream.

Files: `src/main.ts` (routing, URL state, landing page); `src/baby-station.ts` (camera/mic, QR, settings); `src/parent-station.ts` (stream, meters, alerts, reconnection); `src/motion-detection.ts` (frame differencing); `src/utils.ts` (wake lock, media, audio meter); `src/style.css`; `src/dictionary.ts` (room IDs); `*.test.ts` (colocated Vitest); `tests/` (Playwright, excluded from Vitest); `scripts/` (dev certs); `certs/` (self-signed TLS, gitignored keys); `public/` (static assets).

Tasks: camera/mic `src/baby-station.ts`; video/audio/motion/reconnection `src/parent-station.ts`; shared utilities `src/utils.ts`; motion `src/motion-detection.ts`; room IDs `src/dictionary.ts`; routing/state `src/main.ts`; build/deploy `vite.config.ts`, `.github/workflows/depl
